LocalSource.Note: Put the TeamViewer Host MSI (TeamViewer_Host.msi) in that folder. TeamViewer gives it only in the Management Console, under Design and Deploy; unzip the download first when it is a .zip.

InstallerSettings.Label: API token
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: The script token for APITOKEN, from the Management Console. It is written to the install script of the package in clear text. Leave empty to skip.

InstallerSettings.Label: Custom config ID
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: CUSTOMCONFIGID of a custom Host module from the Management Console. Leave empty to skip.

InstallerSettings.Label: Assignment ID
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: ASSIGNMENTID from Management Console, Design and Deploy: the assignment ID of your Host module. Leave empty to skip assignment.

InstallerSettings.Label: Assignment options
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: The flags of ASSIGNMENTOPTIONS, for example --grant-easy-access or --reassign. Leave empty to skip.

InstallerSettings.Label: Remove the desktop shortcut
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Adds DESKTOPSHORTCUTS=0 and ADDLOCAL=ALL REMOVE=f.DesktopShortcut to the msiexec command line.
